title: Implement versioned Python strategy interfaces registry and validated parameters
description:
Create the production Python strategy SDK base and an explicit trusted registry.

In mike_trade/strategies/base.py define:
- An immutable, versioned StrategySpec dataclass (frozen) with these fields: strategy_id, semantic version (validated MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH), side (BUY or SELL), input requirements including reference symbols, required timeframes, warmup bar count, closed-bar-only and volume requirements, trigger kind and schedule (for example EDGE_ON_CLOSED_BAR), parameter schema, persistent state needs, methodology/source metadata, execution limitations, and the enumerated diagnostic reason codes the strategy may emit.
- A ParameterSpec/ParameterSchema type that validates name, type (int, Decimal, bool, enum, time-of-day), default, inclusive min/max ranges, and allowed choices. Unknown parameters, missing required parameters, out-of-range values, and wrong types must be rejected with a typed validation error. Money and price parameters must use Decimal and must never use float.
- Abstract BuyStrategy and SellStrategy base classes that both expose `spec` and a pure `evaluate(context, params, state)` method. The method takes an immutable MarketContext and returns a strategy evaluation result: either a signal carrying a deterministic signal_id, or a no-signal result with reason codes. Reason codes must include at least SIGNAL, NO_SIGNAL, INSUFFICIENT_DATA, STALE_DATA, and NOT_ELIGIBLE. Nothing returned may be a confidence score.
- A deterministic signal-ID helper. It derives the ID from strategy_id, version, symbol, side, and the triggering completed bar's UTC timestamp, so the same bar always yields the same ID.
- Strategies must receive no broker, no secrets, no filesystem handle, and no network or session client. The base classes must not import broker, adapter, persistence, or HTTP modules.

In mike_trade/strategies/registry.py implement an explicit trusted StrategyRegistry:
- Strategy classes are registered explicitly by import, keyed by (strategy_id, version). Duplicate registration raises an error.
- Lookup by id (latest version or a pinned version) and listing filtered by side.
- Parameter validation is delegated to the spec schema.
- There must be no dynamic code-eval, no entry-point or arbitrary path plugin loading, and no generic rules DSL.
- The BUY and SELL registries are independent. Registering a BUY strategy must not require any SELL partner.

In tests/contracts/test_strategy_registry.py write contract tests for:
- spec immutability and semver validation
- parameter validation, both positive cases and negative cases (unknown, missing, out-of-range, wrong type, float rejected for Decimal parameters)
- rejection of duplicate registration
- lookup by id and version, and side filtering
- signal-ID determinism
- a static check that base.py and registry.py do not import broker, network, or filesystem modules

Before editing, inspect:
- mike_trade/domain/strategy_types.py
- mike_trade/domain/signals.py
- mike_trade/domain/market.py
- mike_trade/market_data/context.py
- mike_trade/signals/rearm.py
- mike_trade/strategies/sell/base.py, if it exists
- any existing mike_trade/strategies/ package files

Reuse existing domain types and do not redefine them. Decision budget: if an existing domain type already covers a concept (signal, side, reason code), import it rather than creating a parallel type.
acceptance_criteria: mike_trade/strategies/base.py defines frozen StrategySpec, parameter schema types, abstract BuyStrategy and SellStrategy with a spec and a pure evaluate(context, params, state) method, and a deterministic signal-ID helper.

StrategySpec carries id, semantic version, side, input requirements/reference symbols, timeframes, warmup, trigger kind/schedule, parameter schema with ranges, persistent state needs, methodology/source metadata, execution limitations, and diagnostic reason codes.
Parameter validation rejects unknown, missing-required, out-of-range, and wrong-type values with a typed error, and money/price parameters are Decimal (float rejected).

StrategyRegistry registers classes explicitly, rejects duplicate (id, version), supports lookup by id/version and listing by side, and contains no eval/exec/importlib-path/entry-point plugin loading or rules DSL.
A BUY strategy can be registered and looked up without any SELL strategy being registered.
Evaluation results expose reason codes including NO_SIGNAL, INSUFFICIENT_DATA, and STALE_DATA, and contain no confidence/probability score field.
Identical inputs produce identical signal IDs, and different completed-bar timestamps produce different signal IDs.
tests/contracts/test_strategy_registry.py contains positive and negative tests for all of the above, and they pass when run in isolation.
base.py and registry.py import no broker, adapter, persistence, HTTP/network, or secrets modules.
forbidden_changes: change PLAN_SKELETON.json or other planning artifacts
add a generic rules DSL or arbitrary code-eval/dynamic plugin loader
give strategies broker, secrets, filesystem, or network access
add confidence scores or profitability claims
use float for money, price, or quantity values
create live broker orders or run broad test suites/backtests
